gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The Hanthorn Cannery Foundation was founded in 2003 in Astoria, Oregon by a group former workers and managers of Bumble Bee Seafood Corporation to commemorate the work done by them and thousands of other employees for over a century, and to create a museum in their honor. Bumble Bee was one of many labels trademarked by the Columbia River Packers Association (CRPA) including names of flowers, fish and birds.
